methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page (accessed 2026-06-14). ScraperAPI's pricing page is JavaScript-rendered and returned only navigation HTML on direct fetch; the four public tiers — Hobby $49, Startup $149, Business $299, Scaling $475, plus a 10% annual discount — are confirmed by independent corroboration (proxyway.com review and use-apify.com review, accessed 2026-06-14). Plan names and prices are confirmed; exact credit allocations differ between secondary sources, so credit figures in notes are recorded conservatively/qualified rather than asserted as exact. Bright Data's main /pricing page lists only 'See Pricing' buttons per product; Web Scraper API tier details fetched from brightdata.com/pricing/web-scraper which published Free/Pay-as-you-go/Scale/Enterprise tiers. Oxylabs /pricing returns only starting prices; full Web Scraper API plan table fetched from oxylabs.io/products/scraper-api/web/pricing. Zyte uses a commitment-based usage-metered model with no flat named tiers; monthlyUsd reflects the minimum monthly commitment and per-1K-request unit rates are in notes. SerpApi pricing fetched directly from serpapi.com/pricing. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: ScraperAPI
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.scraperapi.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14 — page is JavaScript-rendered, returned navigation HTML only on direct fetch. Plan names and prices confirmed via independent corroboration: Hobby $49, Startup $149, Business $299, Scaling $475, with a 10% annual discount (proxyway.com/reviews/scraperapi and use-apify.com/blog/scraperapi-review, accessed 2026-06-14). Entry plan includes 100k credits at 20 concurrency. Exact credit allocations for higher tiers differ between secondary sources and are recorded qualified, not asserted as exact.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: 100,000 API credits/month, 20 concurrent threads, US/EU geolocation only, 2-week data retention. 10% discount on yearly contracts confirmed by proxyway.com review.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: Second of four public tiers, named Startup; price $149/month confirmed by independent reviews (proxyway.com, use-apify.com). Includes ~1,000,000 API credits/month (figure varies between secondary sources; recorded qualified). US/EU geotargeting.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Third of four public tiers, named Business, at $299/month; price confirmed by independent reviews (proxyway.com, use-apify.com). Unlocks global geotargeting (US/EU restriction lifted) and includes ~3,000,000 API credits/month (figure varies between secondary sources; recorded qualified).

plans.name: Scaling
plans.notes: Highest public self-serve tier, named Scaling, at $475/month with 5,000,000+ API credits and 200+ concurrent threads. Price and name confirmed via independent reviews. Custom enterprise pricing available beyond this tier via sales.
